gloss: paper tiger; someone who only looks strong

definitions.gloss: paper tiger; someone or something that only looks strong
definitions.explanation: A person, organization or threat that looks powerful or frightening but has no real strength. Literally a papier-mâché tiger, a traditional folk toy whose head bobs on a spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{張|は}り{子|こ}の{虎|とら}だ。
examples.english: That company is a paper tiger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強|つよ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{張|は}り{子|こ}の{虎|とら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: He acts tough, but he's nothing but a paper tiger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{罰則|ばっそく}→罰則：27147_bassoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{張|は}り{子|こ}の{虎|とら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The new rule has no penalties, so people call it a paper tiger.

notes:
Because the toy tiger's head nods at the slightest touch, the phrase was once also used for a person who nods along to anything; today the "only looks strong" meaning is the usual one.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{張|は}り{子|こ}の{虎|とら}だ: X is a paper tiger
- {張|は}り{子|こ}の{虎|とら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: is no more than a paper tiger

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{見|み}かけ→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧{倒|だお}し: something that looks better than it is
